content.text: File systems, concurrency primitives, and I/O scheduling determine how operating systems manage persistent storage, coordinate parallel execution, and handle device communication.

items: File Systems — File system design, journaling, inodes, and storage abstractions
Concurrency Primitives — Mutexes, semaphores, condition variables, and lock-free programming
I/O and Scheduling — I/O models, disk scheduling, and process scheduling algorithms
